data.vehicle_damage_summary: The vehicle has sustained severe front-end collision damage, primarily concentrated on the front right corner. The front bumper cover and right front headlamp assembly have been completely detached from the vehicle, with the headlamp shattered and the bumper cover lying on the ground. Hidden and adjacent structural parts, including the front bumper reinforcement bar and energy absorber, are compromised due to the severity of the impact. The front grille and emblem are also damaged as part of the detached bumper assembly.
